text: 【中国银行启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动 为算力产业链提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持】2026中国算力大会期间，中国银行在工业和信息化部、中国人民银行指导支持下，会同中国电信、中国移动、中国联通、中国人民保险、中国东方资产、国银金融租赁等生态伙伴，共同启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动。“十五五”期间，中国银行将携手保险、产业投资、资产管理和金融租赁等算力生态伙伴，共建“算力+”产业金融生态，为算力产业链上下游企业提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持，支持不少于100个重点智算中心项目，为国家算力互联互通区域节点提供跨区域、一体化协同金融服务，赋能3000家以上用算企业。
text_en: [Bank of China launches the "One Network, Three Integrations" computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative, providing no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support for the computing power industry chain] During the 2026 China Computing Power Conference, Bank of China, under the guidance and support of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the People's Bank of China, together with ecosystem partners including China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom, PICC, China Orient Asset Management, and CDB Financial Leasing, jointly launched the "One Network, Three Integrations" computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, Bank of China will work with computing power ecosystem partners in insurance, industrial investment, asset management, and financial leasing to jointly build a "computing power+" industrial finance ecosystem, provide no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support to upstream and downstream enterprises in the computing power industry chain, support no fewer than 100 key intelligent computing center projects, provide cross-regional, integrated coordinated financial services for national computing power interconnection regional nodes, and empower more than 3,000 computing-using enterprises.
